name: stem-shovel-house-rules
description: The conventions in CLAUDE.md that can be checked mechanically, for `fallow audit` (CI) and `fallow guard`.

rules.message: Read configuration through `import { ENV } from "varlock/env"`, never SvelteKit's $env/* (docs/environment.md).
Every mutation is a `form` or `command` remote function in src/lib/remote/*.remote.ts, validated by a valibot schema; no form actions (CLAUDE.md).
valibot for validation, native Intl/Date for dates, fetch for HTTP and varlock for env; these packages are not used here.

$effect is a last resort: $derived (writable since 5.25) for anything computable from other state, function bindings for linked inputs, {@attach} for element-scoped DOM work, <svelte:window>/<svelte:document> for global listeners, prop-seeded state plus {#key} for drafts a server value resets. A real side effect (canvas, an external engine or library, a timer, the popover API) keeps its $effect with a `// why $effect: <which>` comment on the line before it; the test beside src/lib/utils/effectCallSites.ts gates on it and `bun run audit:effects` lists every site (docs/testing.md "The $effect audit"). This Fallow finding is a reminder: Fallow 3.34 misplaces a Svelte file's $effect lines, so its own suppressions do not apply here.
In a component, listen on window/document with <svelte:window on…> / <svelte:document on…>, which clean up with the component.
